suggestedPeers.name: kempo-media
suggestedPeers.reason: Pictures and videos for products, shown in a gallery on the product page

widgets.title: Products
widgets.description: How many products there are, and the latest products.

page_widgets.title: Product list
page_widgets.description: A list of products, limited by category, tag, availability or stock, as on the products page.

attributes.name: category
attributes.label: Category
attributes.hint: Only products in this category. Use the category's key, such as shirts.

attributes.name: tag
attributes.label: Tag
attributes.hint: Only products with this tag. Several tags, comma separated, need all of them.

attributes.name: slugs
attributes.label: Products
attributes.hint: Only these products, by slug, comma separated, in this order.

attributes.name: search
attributes.label: Search text
attributes.hint: What the search box starts with. Visitors can change it unless the controls are hidden.

attributes.name: hide-controls
attributes.label: Hide the search and sort controls

page_widgets.title: Product
page_widgets.description: One product, with its picture, price, options and details, as on its own page. Widgets such as Add to cart go in its slots.

attributes.name: product-id
attributes.label: Product
attributes.hint: The product this shows. Products are made under Products in the admin.

page_widgets.title: Parent Product
page_widgets.description: Nothing shows here. Put the parts of a product page inside it (gallery, title, price, options, details, add to cart) and they show that product.

attributes.name: product-id
attributes.label: Product
attributes.hint: The product its parts show. Products are made under Products in the admin.

page_widgets.title: Product gallery
page_widgets.description: The pictures and videos of the product in the Parent Product, with thumbnails to choose from.

attributes.name: thumbs-position
attributes.label: Thumbnails
attributes.hint: Where the strip of thumbnails sits, beside or below the large picture.

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.label: Shape
attributes.hint: The shape of the large picture as width/height: 1/1 is square, 4/3 or 16/9 are wider.

attributes.name: no-fullscreen
attributes.label: No fullscreen
attributes.hint: Clicking a picture does not open it fullscreen.

page_widgets.title: Product title
page_widgets.description: The name of the product in the Parent Product, as a heading.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.label: Inline
attributes.hint: Sits on the line with the content around it, instead of on a line of its own.

page_widgets.title: Product price
page_widgets.description: The price of the product in the Parent Product, for the options chosen.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.label: Inline
attributes.hint: Sits on the line with the content around it, instead of on a line of its own.

page_widgets.title: Product short description
page_widgets.description: The short description of the product in the Parent Product.

page_widgets.title: Product options
page_widgets.description: The options of the product in the Parent Product (size, colour and so on), one dropdown each.

attributes.name: defaults
attributes.label: Starting choices
attributes.hint: What each option starts on, as JSON of option key to choice key. Set from the dropdowns.

page_widgets.title: Product description
page_widgets.description: The full description of the product in the Parent Product.

page_widgets.title: Product details
page_widgets.description: The attributes of the product in the Parent Product, as a table.

permissions.name: products:read
permissions.description: See draft and archived products, quantity levels and the ledger in the admin

permissions.name: products:update
permissions.description: Edit products, including their price, options and quantity

permissions.name: products:templates:manage
permissions.description: Create, edit and delete product templates

permissions.name: products:attributes:manage
permissions.description: Create, edit and delete the custom attributes products have

permissions.name: products:categories:manage
permissions.description: Create, edit and delete product categories. Putting a product in a category only needs permission to edit it

permissions.name: products:ledger:add
permissions.description: Add an entry to the ledger: add stock to products, or take it away

permissions.name: products:settings:manage
permissions.description: Change the catalog settings: currency, whether prices are shown, the page size and what a credit is worth

settings.name: currency
settings.description: The three-letter currency code prices are shown in, e.g. usd, eur, gbp

settings.name: prices_visible
settings.description: Show prices to visitors. Turn off to run a catalog that never shows what things cost

settings.name: page_size
settings.description: How many products the public product list shows per page

groups.name: kempo-products:viewer
groups.description: Can see everything in the catalog, including drafts, but not change it

groups.name: kempo-products:manager
groups.description: Can add, edit and delete products and add entries to the ledger

groups.name: kempo-products:admin
groups.description: Can manage products, and set up the templates and attributes they have
